chapters.title: Welcome to Machine Learning 🎉
chapters.description: Discover what machine learning is, why it’s everywhere, and the three main learning styles that power smart apps.

chapters.title: Data: The Fuel of ML 📊
chapters.description: Understand the lifeblood of ML: datasets, features, labels, cleaning, and the crucial train/test split.

chapters.title: Supervised Learning: Regression 🧮
chapters.description: Predict numbers like a pro. Master linear regression, cost functions, gradient descent, and evaluation metrics.

chapters.title: Supervised Learning: Classification 🏷️
chapters.description: Teach machines to sort data: logistic regression, decision trees, k‑NN, and how to measure success.

chapters.title: Unsupervised Learning: Clustering 🌌
chapters.description: Find hidden patterns without labels. Explore k‑means, hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, and real‑world uses.

chapters.title: Dimensionality Reduction & Feature Engineering 🔧
chapters.description: Tame high‑dimensional chaos with PCA, feature selection, scaling, and encoding for better models.

chapters.title: Ensemble Methods: Wisdom of Crowds 🤝
chapters.description: Combine multiple models for rock‑solid predictions. Bagging, random forests, boosting, and stacking explained.

chapters.title: Introduction to Neural Networks 🧠
chapters.description: Mimic the brain! Perceptrons, activation functions, multi‑layer networks, and the magic of backpropagation.

chapters.title: Deep Learning & CNNs 📷
chapters.description: Dive into convolutional neural networks, image classification, and the layers that see like a human.

chapters.title: Natural Language Processing 📝
chapters.description: Make machines understand text: preprocessing, word embeddings, RNNs, and sentiment analysis.

chapters.title: Model Deployment & Ethics 🚀
chapters.description: Take models to production with APIs, handle bias, ensure fairness, and build trustworthy AI.

chapters.title: Capstone Project & Next Steps 🏆
chapters.description: Combine everything you’ve learned into a final project and discover where to go from here.
